messages:
Marco (Sales): Finlytics POC in EU blocked. They pinned `rwd-gpt-large-v1` to eu-west-1 and get 503 `model_unavailable_in_region`. Paid pilot, need ETA.
Jamie (SE): Are they Hosted or Dedicated? Paste the raw response.
Marco (Sales): Hosted reserved capacity. Response: 503 `{"error":"model_unavailable_in_region","detail":"requested model binary not provisioned in region"}` req_id req_0a1b2c.
Rita (SRE): Logs show model build was deprecated in eu-west after a quant rollback last week.
Finlytics POC (Customer): Demo tomorrow, can't move data outside EU. Can you unpin to a compatible variant?
Jamie (SE): Options: 1) fallback to `rwd-gpt-large-v1-quant-eu` (fast) or 2) reprovision original build in eu-west (6-8h). Need security signoff for fallback.
Anita (Security): Quantized variant must use customer-managed KMS and preserved provenance. Can't accept otherwise.
Lee (Product): That non-quant build was removed for perf. `-quant-eu` is verified but not in default fallback policy.
Rita (SRE): If they need <2h, enable fallback to `-quant-eu` (minutes) and run 2h canary. Reprovision takes ~6-8h.
Marco (Sales): Customer ok with quantized if KMS is customer-managed and logs stay in EU. Also wants cost delta.
Jamie (SE): Quantized ~30% cheaper per-token. Slight quality differences; we'll flag it.
Anita (Security): @ops-bot check artifact signing for `rwd-gpt-large-v1-quant-eu`.
ops-bot: artifact-check: signed=true, sign_key=kms://projects/finlytics-eu/keys/poc-key, provenance=verified, acl=restricted.
Rita (SRE): KMS present. Enabling tenant fallback for finlytics-123 -> `rwd-gpt-large-v1-quant-eu`. Will monitor canary.
Lee (Product): Filing ticket to add this variant to Hosted EU fallback list.
Marco (Sales): Plan: enable quant fallback now, canary 2h, reprovision if issues. Customer agreed.
Finlytics POC (Customer): Confirm when enabled and provide written KMS/logs confirmation.
Anita (Security): I'll post verification note and update security questionnaire addendum.
Jamie (SE): Sending cost delta and sample comparison.
Rita (SRE): Fallback enabled for finlytics-123. Metrics: p85=120ms, error_rate=0.2%.
ops-bot: deploy-log: fallback-policy update applied for tenant finlytics-123 by rita_sre change-id cid_8921.
Marco (Sales): Customer sees responses. Demo rescheduled 09:00 CET. They want fallback/rollback line in quote.
Lee (Product): We'll add POC addendum language for fallback and KMS invariants.
Marco (Sales): Thanks team, closing loop. :thumbsup:
